title: Build an inventory app as catalog, movement and reorder increments
request: Build an inventory app in three separately reviewed plan increments, whose outcomes name catalog, movements and report respectively. Record catalog -> movements -> report dependencies and finish each with its own check. src/catalog.mjs exports createCatalog(rows): detached SKU-sorted rows {sku,quantity,reorderAt}; reject blank/duplicate SKU and negative or non-safe-integer numeric fields with code invalid. src/movements.mjs exports applyMovements(catalog,movements): apply signed safe-integer deltas sequentially to a detached copy; reject missing SKU (not-found), negative resulting stock, noninteger delta or overflow (invalid), leaving input unchanged on all outcomes. src/report.mjs exports reorderReport(catalog): SKU-sorted {sku,quantity,needed} for quantity <= reorderAt, where needed=reorderAt+1-quantity. Demonstrate a movement changing the reorder report.
seededFailure: Only empty module stubs exist. An app that covers the happy path but collapses the requested reviewed increments is incomplete. The grader tests invalid catalog input, atomic stock movements, the inclusive reorder threshold and explicit distinct completed plan items with catalog-to-movement-to-report dependencies.
